description: Hourly averages kept, raw readings dropped after 90 days.
rationale: The dashboards read hours after the first week; the raw rows are kept for a quarter for audits, and not longer.

intents.name: readings_hourly
intents.query: SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', ts) AS bucket, device_id, avg(value) AS avg_value, count(*) AS readings FROM public.readings GROUP BY 1, 2
